title: Dual-rater consensus with arbitration
description: Two blind raters assess items, reconcile bounded disagreements, and escalate residual splits to an arbitrator.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: dual-rater-consensus-arbitration
  title: Dual-rater consensus with arbitration
  description: Two blind raters assess items, reconcile bounded disagreements, and escalate residual splits to an arbitrator.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Produce auditable consensus decisions while preserving independent judgment.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 3
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - signoff
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Items and scoring rubric
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - items
          - rubric
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: rater-a
      kind: agent
      name: Independent rater A
      role: Blind evaluator
      prompt: Score every item against the rubric. Return decision, criterion scores, evidence, and confidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: rater-b
      kind: agent
      name: Independent rater B
      role: Blind evaluator
      prompt: Independently score every item without viewing rater A. Return decision, criterion scores, evidence, and
        confidence.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: compare
      name: Identify disagreements
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      role: Consensus comparison analyst
      prompt: Compare both ratings by item and criterion. Return agreements, disagreements, evidence differences, and
        unresolvedCount without changing either independent rating.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
    - id: reconcile
      kind: loop
      name: Bounded re-rate loop
      config:
        body:
          - rater-a
          - rater-b
          - compare
        exitCondition: compare.unresolvedCount == 0
        maxIterations: 2
        onExhausted: continue
    - id: arbitrator
      kind: agent
      name: Third-party arbitrator
      role: Neutral senior reviewer
      prompt: Resolve only residual disagreements using the rubric and cited evidence. Record rationale and final ruling.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - classify
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: signoff
      kind: approval
      name: Decision owner sign-off
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Consensus decisions and arbitration log
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: rater-a
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: rater-b
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: rater-a
      to: compare
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: rater-b
      to: compare
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: compare
      to: reconcile
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: compare
      to: signoff
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e7
      from: reconcile
      to: arbitrator
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exhausted
    - id: e8
      from: arbitrator
      to: signoff
      kind: dependency
    - id: e9
      from: signoff
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: reconcile-exit
      from: reconcile
      to: signoff
      kind: control
      condition: loop_exit
